course_name_original: Computer simulation of systems and processes
course_name_en: Computer simulation of systems and processes

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge on basic methods of modeling and simulations of systems and processes described by algebraic, differential and integral systems of equations with examples from engineering, biology, chemistry, economy etc.

syllabus_topics: Basic definitions and methods used in modeling and simulations
Equilibrium systems: Discrete and continuous mechanical systems
Systems in biology, chemistry and economy

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation of projects (codes with simulations done by students)
